pages.text: {{hero}} is in the ocean. {{hero}} has a pal. The pal is a shark! It is big and tan, and it is fun.
{{hero}} and the shark go to a big pit. A red gem is in the pit! Can {{hero}} get it for Mom?
But the gem is in a tin can. The lid is on. {{hero}} tugs and tugs, but the lid is set. It did not pop.
The shark hits the lid. Bam! The lid pops up! {{hero}} gets the gem. {{hero}} and the shark did it. Yes!
{{hero}} is in bed. Mom has a hug for {{hero}}. But the gem has a dot on it. The dot is a map! What is on the map?
